MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 19 th DAY OF FEBRUARY 2020 
 
 Present 
 
 Imran Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Director 
 
 Imran Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 ADVANCEMENT OF LOAN TO ZAMEEN AXIS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs . 100,000,000 (Rupees one hundred million ) to Zameen Axis (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan , Chief Executive of the Company, t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs . 100,000,000 (Rupees one hundred million ) to the Borrower. 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Imran Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Company Secretary
